name: @tropass/mcp-installer
description: Installer for configuring agents to use the Tropass remote MCP gateway.

scripts.build: node -e "const fs = require('node:fs'); fs.rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true }); fs.mkdirSync('dist/instructions', { recursive: true }); fs.copyFileSync('instructions/tropass-mcp.md', 'dist/instructions/tropass-mcp.md')" && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
